spans.s:
भृङ्ग भृङ्ग, अस्, आ, ई, m. f. (probably fr.
rt. भ्रम्, cf. भ्रमर; said in Uṇādi-s.

.
to be fr. rt. भृ), a species of large black bee, the
humble bee; (अस्), m. = भृङ्गरोल, a species of
wasp, either the common kind or the Vespa Solitaria;
the fork-tailed shrike, Lanius Cærulescens; a bird,
apparently a sort of shrike different from the pre-
ceding; a libertine, catamite, lecher; the plant
Eclipta Prostrata (= भृङ्ग-राज, मार्कव, केश-
राज); = भृङ्गार, a golden vase or pitcher; (ई),
f. a species of poisonous plant, = अति-विषा; (अम्),
n. woody Cassia (= त्वक्-पत्त्र); the plant Eclipta
Prostrata or Verbesina Prostrata; talc; [cf. पञ्च-
भ्˚.]
—भृङ्ग-ज, अम्, n. aloe wood or Agallo-
chum; (आ), f. the plant Clerodendrum Siphonanthus
(= भार्गी).
—भृङ्ग-पर्णिका, f. small carda-
moms.
—भृङ्ग-प्रिया, f. ‘liked by bees,’ the plant
Gærtnera Racemosa.
—भृङ्ग-मारी, f. = भृङ्-
गारि.
—भृङ्ग-मूलिका, f. a species of plant (=
भ्रमर-च्छल्ली).
—भृङ्ग-रज, अस्, or भृङ्-
ग-रजस्, आस्, m. the plant Eclipta Prostrata.
—भृङ्ग-रस, अस्, m. the juice of the plant
Eclipta Prostrata.
—भृङ्ग-राज, अस्, m. ‘bee-
king,’ a species of large bee, the humble bee; a
species of bird (apparently the variety of shrike
termed Malabar, Lanius Malabaricus); a spreading
shrub, Eclipta Prostrata [cf. नील-भ्˚, पीत-भ्˚]; a
kind of oblation or sacrifice.
—भृङ्ग-राजक, अस्,
m. a species of bird.
—भृङ्गराज-रस, अस्, m.
the juice of the plant Eclipta Prostrata.
—भृङ्ग-
वल्लभ, अस्, m. ‘favourite of bees,’ a species of
[]
Kadamba plant, Ligusticum Ajowan, = धारा-क-
दम्ब and भूमि-कदमब; (आ), f. = भूमि-
जम्बू.
—भृङ्ग-वृक्ष, अस्, m. ‘bee-tree,’ per-
haps = भृङ्ग-रजस्.
—भृङ्ग-सोदर, अस्, m.
the plant Eclipta Prostrata.
—भृङ्गाधिप (˚ग-
अध्˚), अस्, m. ‘bee-chief,’ the queen of the bees.
—भृङ्गानन्दा (˚ग-आन्˚), f. ‘bee-joy,’ the plant
Jasminum Auriculatum (= यूथिका).
—भृङ्गा-
भीष्ट (˚ग-अभ्˚), अस्, m. ‘liked by bees,’ the
Mango tree.
—भृङ्गारि (˚ग-अरि), इस्, m. ‘bee-
enemy,’ a species of flower growing in Mālwa (=
केविका).
—भृङ्गावली (˚ग-आव्˚), f. a line or flight
of bees.
—भृङ्गाह्व (˚ग-आह्˚), अस्, m. the plant
Eclipta Prostrata; another plant, = जीवक; (आ), f.
another plant (= भ्रमर-च्छल्ली).
—भृङ्गी-
फल, अस्, m. the hog-plum, Spondias Mangifera.
—भृङ्गेष्टा (˚ग-इष्˚), f. ‘liked by bees,’ N.
of several plants (= घृत-कुमारी, भार्गी, त-
रुणी, काक-जम्बू).

भृङ्गक, अस्, m. the fork-tailed shrike; (at the
end of an adj. comp.) = भृङ्ग, a bee.

भृङ्गरिटि or भृङ्गरीटि, इस्, m. or भृङ्ग-
रीट, अस्, m., N. of one of Śiva's attendants; [cf.
भृङ्गिन्, भृङ्गीरिटि.]

भृङ्गरोल, अस्, m. (said to be fr. भृङ्ग and
rt. रु, to cry), a kind of wasp; [cf. वरोल.]

भृङ्गाय, Nom. A. भृङ्गायते, -यितुम्, to
become a bee, behave like a bee.

भृङ्गार, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. rt.
भृ), a golden pitcher or vase; a vase used at the
inauguration of a king, (it might be made of any
one of eight different substances, viz. gold, silver,
brass, iron, earthenware, sandal-wood, crystal, or
horn, and might be of eight differents forms); (अस्),
m. = भृङ्ग-राज, the shrub Eclipta Prostrata; (ई),
f. a cricket; (अम्), n. cloves; gold.

भृङ्गारीट, अस्, m. = भृङ्गरीट under भृङ्-
गरिटि above.

भृङ्गि, इस्, m., N. of one of Śiva's attendants;
[cf. भृङ्गिन्.]

भृङ्गिन्, ई, m. the Indian fig-tree; N. of one
of Śiva's attendants [cf. भृङ्गरिटि, भृङ्गिरिटि];
N. of a people; (इणी), f. a species of tree (= वटी).
—भृङ्गीश (˚गि-ईश), ‘lord of the Bhṛṅgins,’
an epithet of Śiva.

भृङ्गिरिटि or भृङ्गीरिटि or भृङ्गिरीटि or
भृङ्गेरिटि, इस्, m. = भृङ्गरिटि, q. v.; an epithet
of Śiva?; [cf. भृङ्गीश.]
